    The Best Early Black Friday Jewelry Deals of 2026 to Gift (or Keep for Yourself)

    📅 14 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1002 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Elle

    ⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Black Friday is fast approaching, and one category I’ve been keeping a close eye on is jewelry.
    • Recent findings suggest that with cult-favorite jewelry labels like Catbird, Blue Nile, and Haverhill among those offering impressive discounts, consider this your sign to treat yourself or surprise someone on your list with something special.
    • Ahead, discover the best ELLE-approved jewelry deals to add to your cart while they’re still in stock.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Black Friday is fast approaching, and one category I’ve been keeping a close eye on is jewelry. Much to my delight, some seriously good early deals are already up for grabs, from fine diamonds and dainty everyday essentials to statement pieces that elevate your next night-out look or wedding guest ensemble. To save you the scrolling (and help you score a little sparkle for less), I’ve rounded up the chicest jewelry finds worth shopping ahead of the holiday rush.

    Recent findings suggest that with cult-favorite jewelry labels like Catbird, Blue Nile, and Haverhill among those offering impressive discounts, consider this your sign to treat yourself or surprise someone on your list with something special. Among the can’t-miss finds are diamond tennis bracelets, unique rings to add to your everyday stack, and gemstone studs that instantly glam up any look. And with holiday gifting season upon us, why not check a few names off your list while you’re at it? Some brands are even offering personalized pieces that can be engraved with a loved one’s name or initials for an extra meaningful touch.

    Ahead, discover the best ELLE-approved jewelry deals to add to your cart while they’re still in stock.

    Pandora: 30 percent off storewide from November 12 to December 1.

    Give the fashion girl on your list 12 days of surprises with Pandora’s advent calendar, now 45 percent off. Once she’s unwrapped the last gift, she can keep her fresh finds in the jewelry box they came in.

    Catbird: Sitewide deals starting at 20 percent off from November 16 to November 30.

    I love a hoop that clicks into place without an earring back to fuss with. This Catbird huggie duo, now 15 percent off, includes a smaller, chunkier pair and a larger, diamond-studded style. Keep both for your own rotation, or gift one and save the other for yourself.

    Ring Concierge: 30 percent off sitewide from November 16 through December 1 (plus 20 percent off in-stock lab-grown engagement rings and 10 percent off in-stock natural engagement rings).

    Industry observers note that ring Concierge is treating us to its biggest sale of the year for Black Friday, and among its gleaming selection of bracelets is this elegant diamond-studded bangle. Available in your choice of metal, it’s now priced at just over $2,000. For fine jewelry this stunning, I’d call that a steal.

    With Clarity: Up to 30 percent off sitewide from November 23 to December 3.

    Diamond studs can dress up even the most minimalist outfit. This sparkling four-prong pair is one of my favorite finds from With Clarity’s early Black Friday sale, and you can choose both the metal and carat weight.

    Blue Nile: Up to 40 percent off select jewelry.

    A 14K white gold tennis bracelet at 40 percent off? I don’t need much convincing. This classic Blue Nile design features a single row of round brilliant-cut lab-grown diamonds, each held in a four-prong setting, and fastens with a secure box clasp.

    En Route: 35 percent off sitewide from November 13 to December 2.

    Sources indicate that add a pop of color to any ensemble with these precious peridot drop earrings, now 35 percent off during En Route’s early Black Friday sale. Pair them with the equally chic coordinating necklace, also marked down.

    Awe Inspired: 30 percent off sitewide (excluding solid gold jewelry).

    Sources indicate that beloved for its feminine, celestial-inspired designs, Awe Inspired has dreamed up one of the most enchanting advent calendars of the year. Whether you’re treating yourself or shopping for an unforgettable gift, this gorgeous set is available in 14K gold vermeil or sterling silver and features 12 pieces of jewelry and accessories to unwrap. It’s also 30 percent off during the brand’s Black Friday sale.

    Rogers & Hollands: 20 to 50 percent off sitewide and up to 60 percent off select sale items from November 6 to November 29.

    It has been revealed that lab-grown diamond accents give this slender, 14K gold-plated cuff just enough sparkle to wear on its own, though it layers just as easily with slim bangles or a favorite watch. Right now, it’s over 30 percent off during Rogers & Hollands’ early Black Friday sale.

    Gilded Newly introduced York: Up to 35 percent off sitewide from November 23 to November 30, plus free 1/4-carat diamond studs on orders of $500 or more.

    According to recent reports, an oval cut never goes out of style, and these four-prong lab-grown diamond studs from Gilded Newly introduced York are guaranteed to draw compliments. Choose your carat weight and a setting in 10K or 14K yellow or white gold—all combinations are 20 percent off.

    Haverhill: 25 percent off sitewide from November 13 to November 30.

    In a recent development, haverhill is treating us to 25 percent off sitewide, including this elegant gemstone pendant that makes for an extravagant gift for a loved one. Personalize it with your choice of stone and metal color, whether it’s their birthstone or favorite gem—my pick is a rich red ruby set in gold.

    Astrid & Miyu: 25 percent off everything from November 12 to December 1 with code DREAM25.

    Sources indicate that add an unexpected twist to your ring stack with Astrid & Miyu’s sculptural wave ring, available in both gold and silver. It’s presently 25 percent off as part of the brand’s sitewide sale.

    Jared: 20 percent off select items from November 13 to November 30.

    Whether you’re considering an engagement ring upgrade or shopping for a statement-making cocktail ring, Jared’s nearly sitewide sale is worth a peek. Among the discounted designs is this stunning lab-grown diamond ring, in your choice of precious metal and carat weight.

    #19891. Tech Report: The It-Girl-Approved Airport Pants to Wear on Your Next Trip

    📅 13 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 3m • 📚 Deep Dive (588 w)
    📖 Baca

    Tech Report: The It-Girl-Approved Airport Pants to Wear on Your Next Trip

    📅 13 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (588 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Harpersbazaar

    ⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • There’s nothing quite as chic as having good travel style.
    • These days, sneakers and flats run the show in terms of footwear, but where it gets really interesting is in the pants.
    • According to recent reports, it girls like Gigi Hadid and Kendall Jenner tend to lean into model-off-duty attire in cozy knit bottoms (paired with luxury designer bags) for their busy travel days.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    There’s nothing quite as chic as having good travel style. While we’ve certainly moved on from the days of wearing pencil skirts and heels to walk the glossy airport corridors (thank goodness), jet-set style has evolved into something a little more manageable and comfortable.

    These days, sneakers and flats run the show in terms of footwear, but where it gets really interesting is in the pants.

    According to recent reports, it girls like Gigi Hadid and Kendall Jenner tend to lean into model-off-duty attire in cozy knit bottoms (paired with luxury designer bags) for their busy travel days. Others like Jennifer Lopez, Julia Roberts, and Amal Clooney remain loyal to their jeans, opting for comfortable styles that can support them through the airport chaos.

    According to recent reports, for effortless travel style, celebrities like Jennifer Lawrence, Zoë Kravitz, and Rihanna have a soft spot for the chic pull-on pant. It’s easy, sleek, and practical all in one. What more could you want?

    And then there are other A-listers, like Nicole Kidman and Gwyneth Paltrow, who roll their suitcases in silky pants and tailored jeans, showing the range of sophisticated travel pants.

    As we prepare for a busy holiday travel season, shop Bazaar’s guide to the best airport pants, inspired by a few of our favorite stylish celebs.

    Supermodels like Kendall Jenner and Gigi Hadid always blend comfort and style when they travel, and knit pants are the perfect solution. As evidenced here, no one does model-off-duty quite like the Guest in Residence founder, who shows how to mix cozy layers effortlessly for a long day of travel.

    Guest in Residence Felted Barrel Pants.

    Naked Cashmere Rebecca Cashmere Pants.

    Vince Wool and Cashmere Blend Joggers.

    Favorite Daughter “Just Right” Foldover Pants.

    Sources indicate that an equally comfortable but more luxurious take on the lounge pant is a silk or satin pair. Here, Nicole Kidman styles silky black pants with a matching black button-up and sleek loafers for a minimalist airport ensemble.

    J.Crew Cosmo Pants in Luster Charmeuse.

    Silk Laundry Silk Bias-Cut Pants.

    Jeans and a T-shirt are an outfit formula that always works, even for a long plane ride. Luckily, slouchy, low-rise, and oversize denim styles are trending—as is super-soft denim so cozy, you can take a New York to London red-eye and sleep all night in them.

    Rag & Bone Miramar Sofie Ankle-Length Pants.

    Khaite Karo Mid-Rise Barrel Jeans.

    Citizens of Humanity Ayla Mid-Rise Wide-Leg Jeans.

    Agolde Ren High-Rise Wide-Leg Jeans.

    Bring back dressing up! Emma Corrin knows that a good, loose pair of trousers can take you from the airport to the business meeting to the party—no change needed.

    Toteme Double-Pleat Fluid Trousers.

    Ralph Lauren Bacall Doeskin Wool Pants.

    Cos Relaxed Fluid Wide-Leg Pants.

    Gap 365 High-Rise Linen-Blend Trousers.

    It has been revealed that somewhere between sweatpants and suit pants are pull-on pants. No buttons, no zippers, no problem. Celebrities from Jennifer Lawrence to Zoë Kravitz agree. Style yours with a classic white button-down for a more polished feel.

    Banana Republic High-Rise Wide-Leg Drapey Ponte Pull-On Pants.

    Lululemon Softstreme Pintuck Mid-Rise Pants.

    Leset Kyoto Cotton Drawstring Pants.

    J.Crew Luna Lightweight Corduroy Pants.
